notablePrerequisites: Meloku on the battlefield.You control three Islands.
description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Capture of Jingzhou on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning Mystic Sanctuary from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.
